title: List
body:
Syntax: list

Description: Shows a shopkeeper's for-sale items with prices and a [1], [2], [3] number on each purchasable item. Type BUY 2 to buy the second listed item, or BUY <item name> as before. BUY 2 <item> continues to mean a quantity of two. Player shops number only items with prices; pawnshops number each actual pawned copy. Numbers update as stock changes.

Date: 2026-08-17

Pawnshops list actual one-copy items previously sold by players, with a markup. Ordinary NPC and player shops continue using their usual lists.
